scope: Independent reconstruction of the released Figure 1a code cell with seed 4033; preserves the disagreement with the printed example index 0.49 and control SD 0.26. Not a successful reproduction of those printed control values.
preprocessing: Full 28,530 viable rows in original order; ln(Fit/0.5); effects for G to A at offset 10; RandomState(4033), 88 pairs with replacement, ddof=0. No seed search, no graph pruning, no log-base adjustment.

sources.locator: Results, Epistasis is highly idiosyncratic, p. 1686 (PDF page 2): I_id=0.612 +/- 0.005 s.e.m.; Methods, Estimating the idiosyncrasy index, p. 1692 (PDF page 8).
Code cell 2: mutation (10,G,A), floor exclusion, seed 4033, n=88 log-ratio effects. Values are independent calculations of this procedure; they disagree with the main-text illustrative control.

comparison.justification: Floating-point agreement on fixed input and a fixed RNG stream; not a tolerance fitted to a printed-paper value.
